verdict.rationale: Fellow makes meetings searchable via full transcript search and MCP/API queries like 'what did we decide in last month's standup', which supports surfacing past context with specific people, but there is no documented feature that proactively assembles a pre-meeting brief keyed to attendees or auto-surfaces prior meetings with the same people before a call. missing for 10: a dedicated pre-meeting briefing/prep feature that auto-detects attendees and compiles related past meetings and open action items ahead of the call, plus independent hands-on evidence of this workflow.
